dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: Look, I've caught a major story!

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: I'm fishing for... *ahem* I mean, I'm looking for something I can write a news report about!

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: Ah, you were thinking of jokes about the stereotypes about reporters just now, weren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: It's a production zone, so it's noisy, of course. There are the machines, the clockwork meka... and the loudspeaker!

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: You know, I could probably turn the loudspeaker into a decent news story... yeah, that's a great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: See you. And I hope you catch the fish you want!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did think of a few, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: And you're right to do so! I figured that if I wanted to be a reporter I needed to act like one. So I started to imitate all the stereotypes people have about reporters.

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: Since I reminded you of one, that means I'm doing a good job. Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I thought you were fishing for "fish."

dialogues.speaker: Nelly
dialogues.text: I feel like you're trying to imply something... But you're right! I really want the Platinum Collection and I don't care what anyone else says.
